pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown patches. Edges on the upper neck and shoulder exhibit high-contrast, sharp pixel gradients. Spatial area of patches decreases from the dorsal ridge toward the ventral region, becoming increasingly fragmented and smaller on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological graph of light-tan pathways. Junction nodes typically feature three or four intersecting corridors. Corridor thickness is consistent on the upper neck but expands into wider, less defined negative space in the lower flank and belly transition zones.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the dorsal neck as a dark, short-haired fringe. The profile shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated edge against the lighter background, indicating individual tufts of the mane.
